svg.title: H002 same-context development: matched raw and centroid views
svg.desc: Two archived XY triplets. The southern profile supports an ordinary candidate centroid. The upper Z36 slice shows one centre19; its association with centres across Z remains unresolved. No physical calibration or accuracy estimate.

g.text: Matched XY views of candidate volumetric centroids
A · Ordinary southern profile · Z index 32 · raw window [2750, 22382] · gamma 1
B · Upper profile · Z index 36 · raw window [711, 58564] · gamma 1
Upper XY36 shows one visible centre (19); association with centres across Z remains unresolved.
Fixed contrast within each triplet, different windows between rows · voxel coordinates · no verified physical calibration
